settings.dateFormat: not set: GnuCash's default, locale, which under C is %m/%d/%y; no check reads a date

book: multi-acct-test (:211-229): the expense tree of env-expense-account-structure (test-engine-extras.scm:360-370) and Assets:Bank; each of the seven expense accounts, parents included, gets one transaction per day of the current month from Bank, day N of $N. For the pinned now the month is March 2024, and start-this-month and end-this-month read 2024-03-01 00:00:00 and 2024-03-31 23:59:59 UTC.
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults and in effect for the run. {"relative": name} is a relative date resolved from now.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109) after stripping <script> elements: table 1; row 0 is the <th> header row, row N the Nth data row; null column means every cell. A check with "count" expects the number of cells selected rather than their text.

checks.name: 6 columns
checks.meaning: Six header cells: Date, four account columns at two levels, and the grand total

checks.name: auto
checks.meaning: Second header: Auto, with its three children folded in, is the largest series and comes first under the default Sort Method, descending amount (category-barchart.scm:183-185)

checks.name: multi-acct ratios
checks.meaning: Day 2 (2024-03-02) without its date cell: Auto $8 of $14 (57.14 %), then Expenses, Groceries and Rent at $2 each (14.29 %), and the $14.00 grand total
